beats.title: China Drills Oil Wells in Bamboo
beats.description: Workers in Sichuan sank deep boreholes with bamboo pipes and percussion bits, reaching oil and gas far below ground.
beats.why_in: earliest drilled oil and gas wells
beats.note: Dated 347 CE or earlier in the usual sources

beats.title: Gas Lamps Light a London Street
beats.description: A promoter lit a stretch of a famous London street with coal gas, showing that piped gas could replace candles outdoors.
beats.note: Pall Mall demonstration by Frederick Winsor

beats.title: Fredonia Taps Natural Gas
beats.description: A gunsmith in a small New York town piped gas from a shallow well to nearby buildings, the first commercial natural gas well in America.

beats.title: Baku Drills the First Modern Well
beats.description: On the Caspian shore, a Russian engineer drilled an oil well with a mechanical rig, years before the American boom.
beats.note: Bibi-Heybat well; most sources say 1846, one says 1848

beats.title: Drake Strikes Oil in Pennsylvania
beats.description: Edwin Drake drilled into the ground near Titusville and struck oil, launching the modern petroleum industry.
beats.why_in: birth of the modern oil industry

beats.title: The First Oil Pipeline Flows
beats.description: A short iron pipeline carried crude from a boom town's wells to a railhead, ending the reliance on teamsters and wagons.

beats.title: Rockefeller Founds Standard Oil
beats.description: John D. Rockefeller and partners formed an Ohio company that would grow into the biggest oil monopoly in history.

beats.title: The First Modern Oil Tanker Sails
beats.description: A steamship built with its hull as the cargo tank proved that oil could be shipped cheaply by sea in bulk.

beats.title: Royal Dutch Petroleum Is Founded
beats.description: A company set up to drill in the Dutch East Indies began the road to one of the world's largest oil majors.
beats.why_in: founding of a future oil major

beats.title: Drilling Begins Over the Ocean
beats.description: Wells were built on piers reaching out into the Pacific off California, the first oil drilled over open water.

beats.title: Spindletop Gusher Erupts
beats.description: A Texas salt dome blew in a roaring column of oil, opening the era of Gulf Coast oil and Texas wealth.

beats.title: Oil Found in Persia
beats.description: After years of costly searching, a British-funded drill hit a major oil field in the Middle East.

beats.title: Standard Oil Is Broken Up
beats.description: The US Supreme Court ordered the giant oil trust split into dozens of separate companies.
beats.why_in: end of the Standard Oil monopoly

beats.title: Thermal Cracking Boosts Gasoline
beats.description: A Standard Oil chemist's heat-and-pressure process split heavy crude into far more petrol for the growing car market.

beats.title: Teapot Dome Oil Leases Are Signed
beats.description: A secret deal leasing navy oil reserves to private oilmen exposed bribery at the top of the American government.

beats.title: Baba Gurgur Gusher Erupts in Iraq
beats.description: A well near Kirkuk blew in with a huge fountain of oil, revealing one of the largest fields in the Middle East.

beats.title: The East Texas Oil Field Is Found
beats.description: A wildcatter's well struck a vast field that flooded the market and crashed prices during the Depression.

beats.title: Oil Found on Bahrain
beats.description: An American-drilled well on a small Gulf island found oil, the first strike on the Arab side of the Gulf.

beats.title: Saudi Oil Found at Dammam
beats.description: After years of dry holes, a well in eastern Arabia struck oil in huge quantities, transforming the kingdom.

beats.title: The Big Inch Pipeline Opens
beats.description: A 24-inch pipeline from Texas to the East Coast carried crude past U-boat-infested sea lanes during wartime.

beats.title: Drilling Out of Sight of Land
beats.description: An offshore well in the Gulf of Mexico was drilled where no shore could be seen, launching the offshore oil industry.

beats.title: Iran Nationalizes Its Oil
beats.description: Parliament seized the British-run oil company's assets, setting off a major crisis over control of Middle East oil.

beats.title: Giant Gas Field Found in Groningen
beats.description: A Dutch exploration well hit one of the largest natural gas fields in the world, reshaping Europe's energy.

beats.title: OPEC Is Founded
beats.description: Five oil-producing nations met in Baghdad to form a group to coordinate petroleum policy and defend prices.

beats.title: Torrey Canyon Spills Off Cornwall
beats.description: A supertanker ran aground on rocks, spilling crude onto the coasts of Britain and France in the first huge tanker spill.

beats.title: Santa Barbara Oil Spill
beats.description: A blowout from an offshore platform coated California beaches in crude and helped spark the modern environmental movement.

beats.title: Arab Oil Embargo
beats.description: Arab producers cut off oil to nations backing Israel, quadrupling prices and causing petrol queues in the West.

beats.title: Oil Flows Through Alaska Pipeline
beats.description: The first crude from the North Slope began its long journey south across Alaska to a port on the Pacific.

beats.title: Iran Revolution Sparks Oil Shock
beats.description: Turmoil in a major producer cut supplies, doubled prices and sent drivers back into long fuel queues.

beats.title: Oil Prices Collapse
beats.description: Producers flooded the market and crude lost more than half its value in months, ending the boom of the previous decade.

beats.title: Exxon Valdez Spills in Alaska
beats.description: A tanker ran aground in Prince William Sound and fouled the coast with millions of gallons of crude.

beats.title: Kuwait's Oil Wells Are Set Ablaze
beats.description: Retreating troops set hundreds of wells alight, producing black smoke clouds over the desert for months.

beats.title: Exxon and Mobil Agree to Merge
beats.description: Two descendants of Standard Oil announced a union that would create the largest company in the world.

beats.title: Crude Oil Hits a Record Price
beats.description: Oil surged to nearly 150 dollars a barrel before collapsing as the financial crisis deepened.

beats.title: Deepwater Horizon Spill
beats.description: An explosion on a drilling rig in the Gulf killed eleven workers and spewed oil for months.

beats.title: America Lifts Its Oil Export Ban
beats.description: Congress ended a decades-old ban on selling domestic crude abroad, a result of the shale drilling boom.

beats.title: Saudi Aramco Goes Public
beats.description: The world's biggest oil producer sold shares on its home exchange in the largest stock offering ever.

beats.title: Oil Price Falls Below Zero
beats.description: A collapse in demand during lockdowns pushed a benchmark futures contract to a negative price for the first time.
